blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala will play a qualifier in the first round of the Wuhan Open. Eala is seeded 13th in the WTA 1000 hardcourt event. Only the top eight seeds earned a first-round bye. The Filipino sensation resumes her WTA Tour campaign after settling for bronze at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. Eala’s last appearance on tour was at the Singapore Open, where she had a disappointing stint after getting eliminated by unseeded Russian Tatiana Prozorova in the round of 16.
